description: Dated facts on up to 3 WordPress plugins, from current WordPress.org data: active installs, last update, tested WordPress version, PHP requirement, rating and plain warnings (stale, untested with the current WordPress). Use before recommending, installing, keeping or comparing plugins. Facts only, never a ranking or a pick. A need instead of a name ("booking plugin") returns WordPress.org's own search results with the same facts. Premium and commercial plugins (Gravity Forms, WPML, Elementor Pro) get their vendor and their relation to a free plugin. For vulnerabilities against an installed version, use wp_security.

plugins.description: Up to 3 slugs or names, separated by commas: "contact-form-7, wpforms-lite". Or a need: "booking plugin"

name: wp_plugins
title: Plugin facts
